items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: He was playing up there with Guy Kelly and Henry Allen.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. And let's see, we've got the rhythm covered. Louis Balber, did he ever play one job? No, he never played.

He stayed in New Orleans. Never played one job. You know, we got Fats Martin, somebody told me a good drummer at Astoria. Oh, yeah. And he came all the way down to the house on Mero Street, and he looked like a rag muffin. I said, man, this fellow can't play no drums. But he gave me a good story about how he was going and he could play and all this, that and the other. But I laid it out and the guy killed him. I said, well, this guy must be able to play something anyhow. We'll try him out. Who was he with at the…
